title: Learning to Reason for Factuality
authors_zh: Xilun Chen, Ilia Kulikov, Vincent-Pierre Berges, Barlas Oğuz, Rulin Shao, Gargi Ghosh, Jason Weston, Wen-tau Yih
paper_type_zh: 事实推理数据发布与多阶段后训练配方
best_for_zh: 训练或审计长文本事实推理的研究者
one_line: Releases factual-reasoning SFT and DPO data while online GRPO uses a mixed retrieval-and-judge reward whose rollouts are not released.
该工作发布经筛选的事实推理 SFT 轨迹与偏好对，而 GRPO 阶段采用检索支撑的 claim 核验和 LLM 相关性判断，反馈并非纯程序化。
why: Makes the data and feedback boundary visible for studying how factual precision, supported detail, relevance, and verifier error interact in long-form reasoning post-training.
inclusion_reason: Open factuality construction recipe with released SFT and DPO records and a clearly separable, unreleased online GRPO data plane.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long-chain-of-thought post-training has largely been optimized for tasks with inexpensive deterministic checks, such as mathematics and code. Long-form factual answers do not offer that contract: a response may contain dozens of claims, evidence has to be retrieved, and both claim decomposition and support judgments can be wrong. The paper further shows why factual precision alone is an unsafe reward. A model can improve precision by saying very little, while a reward for the number of supported claims can be inflated with correct but tangential material.

The target data problem is therefore not simply “collect factual answers.” It is to construct fact-seeking prompts, long reasoning responses, preference pairs, and online feedback that jointly expose factual precision, supported detail, and relevance. The card keeps two evidence planes separate: the released offline SFT/DPO records, and the online GRPO interactions that the paper describes but does not release. This distinction matters because the latter depends on live retrieval, claim verification, an LLM judge, and current-policy sampling rather than a static label.

长思维链后训练主要发展于数学和代码等可低成本、确定性校验的任务,而长文本事实回答不具备同样的反馈契约:一个回答可能包含数十条事实主张,系统需要先检索证据,再拆分并判断每条主张是否获得支持,主张抽取和支持性判断本身也可能出错。论文还说明,单独优化事实精确率并不安全:模型可以通过少说内容来提高精确率;若只奖励受支持主张的数量,又可能加入正确但与问题关系不大的材料。

因此,目标并非简单地"收集事实答案",而是构造寻求事实的问题、长推理回答、偏好对,以及同时反映事实精确率、受支持细节和相关性的在线反馈。本卡严格区分两个证据平面:已经发布的离线 SFT/DPO 记录,以及论文描述但未发布的在线 GRPO 交互。后者依赖实时检索、主张验证、LLM 裁判和当前策略采样,不能视为一组静态标签。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The work combines an offline release with an online training recipe.

For the offline plane, Llama 4 synthesizes 7,000 fact-seeking prompts from demonstrations drawn from WildChat and the non-test portion of LongFact. The paper assigns 3,000 prompts to SFT and 4,000 to an RL split. Ten candidate long-CoT responses are generated per prompt. SFT keeps the candidate with the highest VeriScore factual precision. DPO chooses the pair with the largest precision gap, provided the gap exceeds 0.1 and the relative length difference is at most 0.1; otherwise the prompt is discarded. The released Hugging Face files contain exactly 3,000 SFT rows and 3,706 DPO rows.

For the online plane, GRPO samples fresh responses from the current policy. ScalableVeriScore extracts claims, searches for evidence, and counts supported and total claims; an LLM comparison supplies a relevance/quality signal. The general reward design exposes factual precision, supported-detail, and relevance components so that the trainer can trade off accuracy, coverage, and pertinence. The release provides code and prompt-preparation scaffolding, but not the original 4,000 online prompts, policy rollouts, evidence histories, or per-component reward logs.

该工作把离线数据发布与在线训练配方结合起来。

在离线平面,Llama 4 参考来自 WildChat 和 LongFact 非测试部分的示例,合成 7,000 个寻求事实的问题。论文将其中 3,000 个划入 SFT,4,000 个划入 RL。每个问题生成 10 个长思维链候选回答。SFT 保留 VeriScore 事实精确率最高的候选;DPO 在精确率分差大于 0.1 且相对长度差不超过 0.1 时,选择分差最大的回答对,否则丢弃该问题。Hugging Face 实际发布文件包含 3,000 条 SFT 记录和 3,706 条 DPO 记录。

在在线平面,GRPO 从当前策略采样新回答。ScalableVeriScore 抽取事实主张、搜索证据,并统计受支持主张数和主张总数;另一个 LLM 比较提供相关性与总体质量信号。通用奖励设计暴露事实精确率、受支持细节和相关性三个分量,使训练者能够权衡准确性、信息覆盖和切题程度。发布内容提供代码和提示准备脚手架,但未提供原始 4,000 个在线提示、策略 rollout、证据历史或各奖励分量日志。

title: Method
方法
html:
Prompt construction starts from two demonstration pools: diverse real-user prompts from WildChat and fact-seeking prompts from the non-test LongFact split. Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8 is prompted to synthesize questions that resemble real use while requiring factual knowledge. The dataset card attributes the released prompts and responses to Llama 4 and Llama 3.3 outputs, respectively.

Offline supervision is selected from ten responses per prompt. SFT stores the best-precision response as src/tgt, with the target formatted as a think reasoning block followed by an answer final-response block. DPO stores src, tgt_chosen, tgt_rejected, pairwise, veriscore_margin, and chosen/rejected lengths. Pair selection controls both score separation and length, reducing a shortcut in which factual responses win merely because they are shorter. The release does not include the other candidates or the evidence used to score them.

Online GRPO uses Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct initialization after SFT, four rollouts per prompt, temperature 1.0, and a 2,048-token rollout cap in the released policy config. ScalableVeriScore parallelizes claim extraction, Serper-backed Google Search retrieval, and claim verification; the paper reports Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct workers for its training-time service. An LLM judge compares a rollout with a reference answer for relevance and overall quality. The paper defines a three-part reward family, while the released main grpo.yaml sets the explicit detail weight to 0.0 and the judge weight to 0.1. Exact reproduction therefore requires pinning the config, verifier models, search results, and judge prompt rather than relying on the high-level formula alone.

提示构造使用两组示例:来自 WildChat 的多样化真实用户提示,以及 LongFact 非测试划分中的寻求事实提示。研究者提示 Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8 合成既接近真实使用、又需要事实知识才能回答的问题。数据集卡将发布的提示和回答分别归因于 Llama 4 与 Llama 3.3 的输出。

离线监督从每个问题的 10 个回答中筛选。SFT 以 src/tgt 保存事实精确率最高的回答,目标由 think 推理块和随后的 answer 最终回答块组成。DPO 保存 src、tgt_chosen、tgt_rejected、pairwise、veriscore_margin,以及选中和拒绝回答的长度。成对筛选同时约束分数差与长度差,以减少"更短的回答仅因更短而获胜"的捷径。发布数据未包含其余候选,也未包含评分时使用的证据。

在线 GRPO 以经过 SFT 的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 为起点;发布的策略配置对每个提示采样 4 个 rollout,温度为 1.0,生成上限为 2,048 token。ScalableVeriScore 并行执行事实主张抽取、基于 Serper 的 Google Search 检索和主张验证;论文报告其训练期服务使用 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct worker。另一个 LLM 裁判把 rollout 与参考回答比较,评估相关性和总体质量。论文提出包含三个分量的奖励族,而发布的主 grpo.yaml 将显式细节权重设为 0.0、裁判权重设为 0.1。因此,精确复现需要固定配置、验证器模型、搜索结果和裁判提示,不能只依赖高层奖励公式。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct variants on LongFact, FAVA, AlpacaFact, Biography, Factory-Hard, and FactBench-Hard. Averaged across these six sets, the reported SFT+GRPO model reaches 68.1% factual precision versus 45.0% for the base model, raises supported-claim detail from 23.5 to 29.0, and obtains a 54.4% judge win rate against the base model. The SFT+DPO model reaches 67.8% precision and 25.7 supported claims but only a 37.8% win rate. The ablation is relevant to the data contract: factual precision and detail can rise even as judged usefulness falls, showing that a high verifier score is not by itself evidence of a good training example.

Artifact inspection supplies a separate kind of evidence. The official release has two raw JSONL files: 3,000 src/tgt SFT rows and 3,706 DPO rows with chosen/rejected responses, a VeriScore margin, and lengths. No GRPO trajectory or reward-log file is present. The current Hugging Face viewer fails when trying to cast the different SFT and DPO schemas together, although both raw files remain downloadable and the repository preparation script reads them separately.

These results demonstrate behavior of the reported trained models, not intrinsic quality, independence, or completeness of every released row. No human audit of the full release, candidate pool, or retrieved evidence is reported.

论文在 LongFact、FAVA、AlpacaFact、Biography、Factory-Hard 和 FactBench-Hard 六个数据集上评估 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的不同后训练版本。六个数据集平均后,SFT+GRPO 模型的事实精确率为 68.1%,基础模型为 45.0%;受支持主张数这一细节指标从 23.5 提升到 29.0;相对基础模型的裁判胜率为 54.4%。SFT+DPO 模型的事实精确率达到 67.8%,受支持主张数为 25.7,但胜率只有 37.8%。该消融结果直接关系到数据契约:事实精确率和细节可能同时提高,而裁判判断的有用性却下降,因此高验证器分数本身不能证明训练样本优质。

对官方产物的检查提供了另一类证据。发布内容只有两个原始 JSONL 文件:3,000 条包含 src/tgt 的 SFT 记录,以及 3,706 条包含选中/拒绝回答、VeriScore 分差和长度的 DPO 记录;其中没有 GRPO 轨迹或奖励日志。当前 Hugging Face 查看器在合并不同的 SFT 与 DPO schema 时转换失败,但两个原始文件仍可下载,仓库中的准备脚本也会分别读取它们。

这些结果说明论文所报告训练模型的行为,不能证明每条发布记录都具有内在质量、相互独立或信息完整。论文未报告对完整发布集、候选池或检索证据的人工审计。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive contribution is the coupling of data construction with a reward-hacking analysis for open-ended factual reasoning. Earlier factuality pipelines could rank answers offline, but online optimization exposes different failure modes: precision favors abstention or brevity, supported-claim counts can reward tangents, and a relevance judge can itself be noisy. This work makes those competing objectives part of one explicit post-training recipe and supplies an accelerated VeriScore service intended for the training loop.

For data curation, the useful novelty is not the number of examples. It is the lineage from grounded prompt synthesis, through ten-way candidate generation and verifier-based SFT/DPO selection, to fresh current-policy GRPO rollouts. The released SFT and DPO rows let a curator inspect the static endpoint of the offline stages, while the code documents how online prompts would be converted and scored. The artifact boundary is equally important: online trajectories and the retrieval evidence behind their rewards remain unreleased, so the public object is an open recipe with partial data, not a complete replayable run.

该工作的独特贡献,是把数据构造与开放式事实推理中的奖励投机分析结合起来。以往事实性流程可以离线排序回答,但在线优化会暴露不同的失败方式:精确率奖励可能鼓励回避或缩短回答,受支持主张数可能奖励离题内容,而相关性裁判本身也可能有噪声。该工作把这些相互制约的目标纳入同一套明确的后训练配方,并提供适合进入训练内循环的加速版 VeriScore 服务。

从数据策展角度看,关键创新不在样本数量,而在完整谱系:以示例为依据合成提示,生成 10 个候选,经验证器筛选形成 SFT/DPO,再由当前策略生成新的 GRPO rollout。发布的 SFT 和 DPO 记录允许策展者检查离线阶段的静态终点,代码则说明如何转换和评分在线提示。同样重要的是产物边界:在线轨迹及其奖励所依据的检索证据仍未发布,因此公开对象是一套带有部分数据的开放配方,而不是可完整重放的训练运行。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The public data does not expose the complete selection history. For SFT, nine rejected candidates per prompt and their scores are absent. For DPO, non-selected pairs and supporting evidence are absent. The original 4,000-prompt online split, GRPO rollouts, claim-level verifier decisions, retrieved documents, and reward-component logs are also absent. The released preparation script can derive a GRPO prompt table from the DPO file, but that is not equivalent to releasing the original online interactions.

The feedback contract is judgment-heavy and non-stationary. Claim boundaries, search results, evidence ranking, verifier model outputs, and the relevance comparison can all change or be wrong. Reproducing the reported service also required substantial infrastructure: the paper reports 32 H100 GPUs for eight Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct verifier workers, in addition to training and policy-inference workers. A mock reward server in the code repository is only for smoke testing and does not produce meaningful factuality rewards.

There are further audit gaps. Only the LongFact demonstrations are explicitly identified as non-test; broader benchmark and retrieval-corpus overlap is unknown. The paper reports one-epoch training, whereas current repository configs contain larger epoch/step limits, so an exact run needs commit- and command-level provenance. Evaluation relies on automated claim verification and an LLM judge over six benchmarks rather than a full human data audit. Finally, CC-BY-NC-4.0, Llama terms, third-party content obligations, and the dataset card's model-naming condition constrain downstream use.

公开数据没有暴露完整筛选历史。对 SFT 而言,每个问题其余 9 个候选及其分数缺失;对 DPO 而言,未选中的回答对和支持证据缺失。原始 4,000 个在线提示、GRPO rollout、主张级验证器判定、检索文档和奖励分量日志也都未发布。仓库中的准备脚本可以从 DPO 文件派生 GRPO 提示表,但这不等同于发布原始在线交互。

该反馈契约高度依赖判断,而且具有非平稳性。事实主张边界、搜索结果、证据排序、验证器模型输出和相关性比较都可能变化或出错。复现论文中的服务还需要大量基础设施:论文报告用 32 张 H100 运行 8 个 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 验证器 worker,此外还需要训练和策略推理 worker。代码仓库中的模拟奖励服务器只用于冒烟测试,不能产生有意义的事实性奖励。

审计仍有其他缺口。论文只明确说明 LongFact 示例来自非测试部分;与其他评测集及检索语料的更广泛重叠情况未知。论文报告训练 1 个 epoch,而当前仓库配置包含更大的 epoch/step 上限,精确复现需要提交版本和执行命令级别的来源记录。评估依赖六个基准上的自动主张验证和 LLM 裁判,而不是完整的人工数据审计。最后,CC-BY-NC-4.0、Llama 条款、第三方内容义务,以及数据集卡中的模型命名条件都会限制下游使用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Construction & Open Releases track, this paper is useful as a compact case study in separating what is released from what is only executable. The SFT file can support studies of long-CoT formatting, factual-answer distillation, and response-level filtering. The DPO file supports preference-learning experiments in which score margin and response-length controls are available as audit fields. Because the two schemas are simple JSONL, researchers can also test alternative filters or compare selected-response distributions without running the online verifier.

The recipe is useful for studying data-process questions that a benchmark score cannot answer: how ten-way sampling changes the retained set; how length matching alters DPO pairs; whether a relevance term reduces tangential but correct answers; and how verifier errors propagate into policy updates. The offline release and online recipe also form a natural comparison between fixed synthetic supervision and on-policy data.

These uses require scope discipline. The release is suitable for reproducing or modifying the offline SFT/DPO inputs and for reimplementing the online scaffold. It is not sufficient to replay the reported GRPO run exactly, because the original online prompt set, trajectories, live search state, and reward logs are missing. Commercial or redistributed-model use additionally requires a license review.

对于"数据构造与开放发布"赛道,这篇论文提供了一个紧凑案例,可用于区分"已经发布的对象"和"只能通过代码执行的过程"。SFT 文件可支持长思维链格式、事实回答蒸馏和回答级筛选研究。DPO 文件可用于偏好学习实验,其中 VeriScore 分差和回答长度可作为审计字段。两个 schema 都是简单 JSONL,因此研究者无需运行在线验证器,也能测试替代筛选规则或比较被选回答的分布。

该配方还适合研究基准分数无法回答的数据过程问题:10 路采样如何改变最终保留集;长度匹配如何影响 DPO 回答对;相关性项能否减少"正确但离题"的回答;验证器错误如何传播到策略更新。离线发布与在线配方也构成了固定合成监督和同策略数据之间的自然对照。

这些用途需要严格限定范围。发布内容足以复现或修改离线 SFT/DPO 输入,也可用于重新实现在线脚手架;但它不足以精确重放论文报告的 GRPO 运行,因为原始在线提示集、轨迹、实时搜索状态和奖励日志均缺失。商业使用或发布训练后模型还需要额外的许可证审查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Released unit: sft/train.jsonl has 3,000 rows with src and tgt; dpo/train.jsonl has 3,706 rows with chosen/rejected responses, a pairwise flag, VeriScore margin, and response lengths.
  • Selection unit: ten candidate responses are generated per prompt; the highest-precision response becomes the SFT target, while DPO retains the maximum-margin, length-matched pair.
  • Online boundary: the paper's 4,000-prompt RL split and GRPO trajectories are not present in the data repository. The preparation script's DPO-derived GRPO prompt file is a reconstruction convenience, not the original rollout release.
  • Feedback unit: ScalableVeriScore supplies claim support statistics using web retrieval; a separate LLM comparison supplies relevance/quality. The released main GRPO config uses four rollouts, temperature 1.0, max_tokens 2048, detail weight 0.0, and judge weight 0.1.
  • Audit priorities: pin code/data revisions, verifier and judge models, prompts, Serper/Google Search state, and exact launch overrides; reconcile paper-versus-config schedules; review CC-BY-NC, Llama, and third-party obligations before reuse.

• 发布单元: sft/train.jsonl 包含 3,000 条 src/tgt 记录;dpo/train.jsonl 包含 3,706 条记录,字段包括选中/拒绝回答、成对标记、VeriScore 分差和回答长度。
  • 筛选单元: 每个提示生成 10 个候选回答;事实精确率最高者成为 SFT 目标,DPO 则保留分差最大且长度匹配的回答对。
  • 在线边界: 论文中的 4,000 个 RL 提示和 GRPO 轨迹没有出现在数据仓库中。准备脚本从 DPO 数据派生 GRPO 提示文件,只是便于重建的做法,不是原始 rollout 发布。
  • 反馈单元: ScalableVeriScore 通过网络检索给出主张支持统计;另一个 LLM 比较提供相关性与质量信号。发布的主 GRPO 配置使用 4 个 rollout、温度 1.0、max_tokens 2048、细节权重 0.0 和裁判权重 0.1。
  • 审计重点: 固定代码与数据版本、验证器和裁判模型、提示、Serper/Google Search 状态及实际启动覆盖参数;核对论文与配置中的训练日程;复用前审查 CC-BY-NC、Llama 和第三方内容义务。

title: Citation
引用
html:
The official repository provides the following preferred citation. It records year = {2025} for the paper and names the accepted venue as ICML 2026; paper.yaml uses the venue year 2026 for atlas indexing.

``bibtex @inproceedings{chen2025learning, title={Learning to Reason for Factuality}, author={Xilun Chen and Ilia Kulikov and Vincent-Pierre Berges and Barlas Oğuz and Rulin Shao and Gargi Ghosh and Jason Weston and Wen-tau Yih}, year={2025}, booktitle={Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)}, url={https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.05618} } ``

Primary artifacts: arXiv 2508.05618, OpenReview byZ7DoyDNd, the facebookresearch/factual_reasoning code repository, the facebook/factual_reasoning dataset, and the facebookresearch/ScalableVeriScore verifier repository.

官方仓库提供了以下推荐引用。该 BibTeX 将论文年份记为 2025,同时把录用会议写为 ICML 2026;paper.yaml 为便于图谱索引采用会议年份 2026。

``bibtex @inproceedings{chen2025learning, title={Learning to Reason for Factuality}, author={Xilun Chen and Ilia Kulikov and Vincent-Pierre Berges and Barlas Oğuz and Rulin Shao and Gargi Ghosh and Jason Weston and Wen-tau Yih}, year={2025}, booktitle={Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)}, url={https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.05618} } ``

主要官方产物包括 arXiv 2508.05618、OpenReview byZ7DoyDNd、facebookresearch/factual_reasoning 代码仓库、facebook/factual_reasoning 数据集,以及 facebookresearch/ScalableVeriScore 验证器仓库。
